SELECT eco_point_history_id AS ecoPointHistoryId, member_id AS memberId, point_amount AS pointAmount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, point_type AS pointType, reference_type AS referenceType, reference_id AS referenceId, created_at AS createdAt FROM eco_point_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT CASE WHEN r.reward_name = 'eco_sticker' THEN '친환경 스티커' WHEN r.reward_name = 'tumbler_coupon' THEN '텀블러 할인 쿠폰' WHEN r.reward_name = 'eco_bag' THEN '에코백' WHEN r.reward_name = 'eco_goods' THEN '친환경 굿즈 세트' ELSE r.reward_name END AS rewardName, COUNT(re.exchange_id) AS itemCount FROM reward_exchange re JOIN reward r ON re.reward_id = r.reward_id WHERE re.member_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY r.reward_id, r.reward_name
